execution.reason: Graph and lifecycle contracts share focused tests and must land serially.

tasks.title: Lock Project Progression Contracts
tasks.description: Focused failing tests define artifact schema, project validation, completion, readiness, activation, compatibility, and read-only lifecycle behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Tests cover missing, duplicate, self, slug-mismatch, and cyclic artifact dependencies.
Tests cover version-2 completion, version-1 migration requirements, empty graphs, current verification evidence, exact blockers, and active-lock eligibility.
Tests prove project reporting and inactive preparation preserve .active byte-for-byte.

tasks.title: Implement Artifact Dependency Semantics
tasks.description: The task-graph module validates whole-artifact dependencies and emits deterministic completion and activation readiness without mutating project files.
acceptance_criteria: Optional root artifact dependencies decode independently from task dependencies.
Project validation returns stable issue codes and deterministic artifact cycles.
Project frontier derives completion, dependency readiness, activation eligibility, and exact blockers.
Existing local APIs and version-1 readability remain compatible.

tasks.title: Wire Prepared-Artifact Progression
tasks.description: Create, plan, ship, research, and lifecycle guidance consistently support prepared inactive artifacts while preserving explicit activation and single-active execution.
acceptance_criteria: Create and plan can target a prepared inactive artifact without changing .active.
Ship refuses ineligible progression and requests immediate approval before an eligible pointer change.
Research can report graph gaps but cannot select, activate, or dispatch work.
The lifecycle continues to define exactly one active artifact and four canonical active-work files.

tasks.title: Verify Integrated Project Progression
tasks.description: The complete feature passes focused and retained checks while proving project reporting is read-only and the current active artifact remains unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: Focused graph and lifecycle tests pass.
The retained suite has no newly introduced failures and owned diffs are clean.
verification: for f in .pi/artifacts/*/tasks.json; do node --experimental-strip-types .pi/scripts/task-graph.ts validate "$f"; done
